sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this Statement object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The exact nullable factory result is rejected before use or assigned as the sole try-with-resources Statement. All success/SQL/Runtime/Error exits close it once; primary-plus-close failure is suppressed by Java, close failure cannot succeed. Borrowed Connection is not owned. Whole18 explicitly verifies these resource paths; no suppression or ignored resource.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this Connection object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact fixture Connection is a Java Proxy with no JDBC driver, database, native stream, socket or file. It owns no closeable OS resource and deliberately rejects close/commit/rollback/setAutoCommit to prove borrowed-connection ownership in both invocations. Statement.close is a separate asserted memory counter, not delegated to any backend.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact standalone JUnit concurrency fixture is outside managed J2EE. Eight owned workers execute64 memory-only JDBC-proxy assertions; every Future joins within5s, finally always shutdownNow and asserts awaitTermination within10s. No driver/DB/network/file/native/service action. Bounded explicit shutdown avoids unbounded implicit ExecutorService.close and is not a blanket Test exclusion.

sourceAnchors.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected.  Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact standalone JUnit memory fixture creates only a Proxy for fixed JDK java.sql.Connection/Statement interfaces, using their defining platform loader. No J2EE/web container, untrusted class name, plugin/context loader or actual JDBC implementation is used. Every non-whitelisted connection/statement call fails an assertion; no acquired handle exists.
